claim: For the fixed three-letter task and the two tested length-two words, existing source operations admit a query-selection witness that realizes the intended word-sum point and its supplied color without inserting that point or color as an answer parameter.
pattern_binding: The pattern is the lattice projection of the canonical source P seed's ordered phase window C0,M0,C1: (000,110,101).
additional_exhaustive_controls: All nine length-two words over indices 0,1,2

source_inventory.forward: GenerativeAssemblyRules.outgoing and validateTransfer; no modified source rules
source_inventory.reference: phaseFrame(chart,origin), with the same fixed observation window[0] for every terminal packet
source_inventory.coefficient_and_reference_retention: Complete packet, chart, five-slot permutation and every phaseAdvanceWitness, including its declared outside-context reference law
source_inventory.color_observation: Read the complete supplied L_2 coloring at the natively selected point. This table lookup is an explicit input observation, not a native packet transfer or a derived physical color law.

program.input: The task and a length-two input word; no desired point, color or selector argument
program.prefix: The existing faithful native word trace, retained unchanged
program.control: A bounded host compiler counts input symbols 1 and 2 and selects the following source-derived instruction program; it neither decodes an endpoint nor computes the desired word sum or consults color values to select the program.

acceptance: Construct the selected point through those actual native suffix transfers from the retained word endpoint. Independently replay the native path and check its terminal window[0] against the word-sum task and supplied color. Compare source-path identity under a changed input coloring.
strongest_controls: erase suffix and recompute a source-valid marker/color
swap source-valid query suffixes while retaining the requested word
boundary: Bounded model-native forward point realization and an explicit input-color observation. The input-dependent instruction compiler remains a host interface. No autonomous native controller, arbitrary word length, arbitrary pattern, native admission of every coloring package, simultaneous occupied assembly, Agda adapter or Ramsey forcing theorem follows.
